# nemau storage object list

List the objects in a container.

The listing follows the platform's page cursor until the container is exhausted,
so a large container takes several requests. --limit stops after that many
objects; the command then prints the cursor to pass to --marker to continue.
The cursor is opaque: pass it back unchanged.

## Usage

```
nemau storage object list <container> [flags]
```

Alias: `ls`

## Options

```
      --limit int       stop after this many objects (default: list them all)
      --marker string   resume a listing from the cursor printed when it stopped
      --prefix string   list only the keys starting with this prefix
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
